note: Written from packages/docs/docs/contributing/project-details/architecture.md, database.md, the ADR page and the bank-sync docs, and the source at the commit above, without any ArchTime output for this repository (it has not been mined). Components are functional and cut across packages: a feature owns its web-app views, its background-server handlers (loot-core) and, where it has one, its sync-server routes. Left unassigned: the docs site, CI actions, the ESLint plugin, e2e tests, mocks and build scripts.
sources: packages/docs/docs/contributing/project-details/architecture.md (web app + background server in a web worker / Electron child process; loot-core; sync-server)
packages/docs/docs/contributing/leadership/architecture-decision-records.md (bank sync credentials on the sync server)

components.name: Budgeting
components.responsibility: Envelope and tracking budgets: budget months, categories and groups, templates, goals, moving money between categories.
evidence: server/budget holds the budget handlers; components/budget the budget views

components.name: Accounts and transactions
components.responsibility: Accounts, account groups, transaction entry and editing, splits, transfers, reconciliation.
evidence: server/accounts, server/transactions; account and transaction views

components.name: Bank sync
components.responsibility: Linking bank accounts and importing their transactions through GoCardless, SimpleFIN, Enable Banking, Akahu and Pluggy; the providers live on the sync server.
evidence: ADR "Bank sync: credential storage" (credentials stay on the sync server)
docs/advanced/bank-sync/*

components.name: Reports and dashboard
components.responsibility: Custom reports, spending / net worth / cash flow, the dashboard and forecasts.
evidence: components/reports is the largest UI area; server/reports, dashboard, forecast

components.name: Rules, payees, tags and filters
components.responsibility: The transaction rules engine, payees, tags and the filter model used to select transactions.
evidence: server/rules is the rules engine; payees and tags are its conditions and actions

components.name: Schedules
evidence: server/schedules

components.name: Formulas and spreadsheet engine
components.responsibility: The reactive spreadsheet that computes budget cells, and the formula language (Peggy grammar) used in templates and reports.
evidence: server/spreadsheet and sheet back every budget number; vite-plugin-peggy builds the formula parser

components.name: Data storage and query layer
components.responsibility: The local SQLite database, migrations, models and mutators, and the AQL query language the UI reads through.
evidence: database.md: SQLite, migrations in loot-core/migrations, functionality in server/db

components.name: Sync and encryption
components.responsibility: Multi-device sync through CRDT messages, end-to-end encryption of the budget file, and the sync endpoints of the sync server.
evidence: getting-started/sync.md; crdt package; server/sync replays and repairs messages

components.name: Budget files, users and server administration
components.responsibility: Opening, creating and closing budget files, sign-in (password, OpenID), users and access, API keys, and the account database of the sync server.
evidence: the sync server holds users, OpenID and secrets; manager is the budget-file chooser

components.name: Import
components.responsibility: Importing budgets and transactions from YNAB 4, nYNAB, Actual exports and files (QIF, OFX, CSV).
evidence: server/importers

components.name: Background server runtime
components.responsibility: The background server of the web worker / Electron process: handler registry, main app, undo, preferences, notes, platform abstractions (browser / Node), shared environment and types.
evidence: architecture.md: the background server runs in a web worker or a Node child process; loot-core uses conditional platform exports

components.name: Web app shell
components.responsibility: The React application frame: bootstrap, routing, sidebar, modals, settings, notifications, news, tour, command bar, themes, shared hooks and state.
evidence: architecture.md: the front-end React-based web app

components.name: Mobile views
components.responsibility: Touch-friendly views of budget, accounts and transactions for small screens.
evidence: components/mobile is the small-screen variant of the main views

components.name: UI component library
components.responsibility: Shared visual components, icons, design tokens and themes, and generic widgets (autocomplete, select, table, forms).
evidence: package @actual-app/components

components.name: Desktop app (Electron)
components.responsibility: The Electron shell: window, menu, preload, security, starting the background server as a child process.
evidence: architecture.md: the Electron app runs the background server as a Node child process over WebSockets

components.name: Public API and CLI
components.responsibility: The @actual-app/api Node package and the actual CLI, which drive the background server from code.
evidence: packages/api and packages/cli

components.name: Sync server core
components.responsibility: The self-hosted sync server: app set-up, configuration, its database and migrations, the CORS proxy, utilities.
evidence: packages/sync-server

components.name: Plugins service
components.responsibility: The service worker that hosts plugins.
evidence: packages/plugins-service
